An alternative to Countdown with free widgets

Countdown by Find Appiness is one of the most popular countdown apps, with more than 188,000 ratings. Its widgets are part of a paid unlock, and the free version shows ads. If you mainly want the countdown on your Home Screen, here's how Simple Count compares.

Facts about the other app come from its own US App Store listing, checked on 17 October 2026. We make Simple Count, so read this with that in mind; tap through to the App Store before you buy. See all apps side by side on our comparison page.

Where Countdown is better

It has an Apple Watch app, counts working days, organises events with tags, and has a very large user base. If you need those, it's a good choice.

Where Simple Count is better

Every widget is free, there are no ads, and the App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected". Shared countdowns stay linked, so a date or photo change updates on everyone's phone and widgets. You also get notes with checklists, Live Activities, Siri and iPhone/iPad sync, all free.

Questions

Is there a countdown app like Countdown but with free widgets?

Yes. Simple Count has every Home Screen and Lock Screen widget free, plus Live Activities and Dynamic Island, with no ads and no subscription.

Can I move my events from Countdown?

Simple Count can import events from your iPhone Calendar. If your countdowns are in your calendar, import them from there; otherwise add them again (Siri makes it quick: "Add a countdown in Simple Count").
